name: prompt-enhancer
description: Sharpens a rough prompt before it is sent: asks a few quick questions when they help, rewrites it using only your words and answers, and waits for you to press Run.

questionsModel.title: Questions model
questionsModel.description: The model that decides whether to ask and writes the questions. haiku asks fewer, better-aimed questions; sonnet asks more.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model that writes the rewrite. sonnet fixes grammar and reads most naturally; haiku is faster and stays closest to your exact words.
